subject.title: [MiniMax] M3 native video input support with timestamp-scaling metadata hint (reference branch only)

question: Should MiniMax M3 native video be implemented as a provider-owned media-understanding capability only, or should OpenClaw also add a core/session VideoContent/readVideo contract for agent tool results?
rationale: Current source has a provider hook seam for video descriptions, but the reference branch also changes core content contracts, prompt/session metadata, and raw video egress policy, which automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Split provider-first
options.body: Accept only a narrow MiniMax plugin video path with explicit egress limits first, and keep core VideoContent/readVideo as a separate design discussion.

options.title: Sponsor core video contract
options.body: Approve a broader session/tool-result VideoContent design and require provider, transport, pruning, and security proof in separate reviewable pieces.

options.title: Fold into broad tracker
options.body: Move the remaining work to the generic direct-video tracker only if maintainers decide the MiniMax M3 timestamp-scaling evidence does not need separate tracking.

recommendation.title: Split provider-first
recommendation.body: Accept only a narrow MiniMax plugin video path with explicit egress limits first, and keep core VideoContent/readVideo as a separate design discussion.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is MiniMax M3 and media-understanding provider ownership on the central files.
